subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular source layout for `scripts/install.sh` now, and should the served public installer remain a generated single-file artifact?
rationale: The request is plausible cleanup on a stable setup surface, but current docs, tests, and website sync assume one directly served shell script, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term artifact strategy.

options.title: Sponsor generated modular source
options.body: Approve a modular source layout only if it still publishes one tested `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact and updates the installer validation matrix in the same change.

options.title: Extract only during bug fixes
options.body: Use this issue as backlog context and extract installer sections only when concrete installer bugs already require that boundary.

options.title: Keep the monolith
options.body: Decide the shell installer should remain single-file to minimize helper-loading and website-publishing risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor generated modular source
recommendation.body: Approve a modular source layout only if it still publishes one tested `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact and updates the installer validation matrix in the same change.

likelyOwner.reason: The current release/current-main history and existing review context make Vincent Koc the strongest routing signal for the installer artifact strategy decision.
